figures.name: Sang Hyang Wenang

ability.name: Before Creation
ability.description: Negate all effects for 1 turn; the void state makes all cards neutral.

figures.description: The supreme primordial deity of Javanese cosmology, the first light in the darkness before creation, grandfather of the gods.

figures.name: Batara Guru (Java)

ability.name: Three-Eyed Vision
ability.description: See all hidden strategies; cancel one ability before it is used.

figures.description: The supreme god of the Javanese pantheon, identified with Shiva, whose lame leg is explained through myth as the price of cosmic knowledge.

figures.name: Semar

ability.name: Punakawan Wisdom
ability.description: Negate the most powerful ability used this turn; wisdom defeats force.

figures.description: The sacred clown-servant Semar, secretly one of the most powerful gods in disguise, the spiritual ancestor of the Javanese people, whose humor masks profound divine truth.

figures.name: Gareng

ability.name: Lame Wisdom
ability.description: Point out a hidden flaw in one enemy ability; reduce its effectiveness by half.

figures.description: The first son of Semar in Javanese wayang, with a crooked arm and lame foot symbolizing human imperfection, yet loyal and wise.

figures.name: Petruk

ability.name: Long-Nose Sniff
ability.description: Detect all hidden cards and strategies; reveal one to your hand.

figures.description: The second son of Semar, the tall clown with a long nose, known for his quick wit and adaptability in the Javanese shadow play.

figures.name: Bagong

ability.name: Blunt Truth
ability.description: Force one enemy to reveal their next action; you may respond before it resolves.

figures.description: The youngest and most earthy of Semar's sons in the punakawan clown quartet, symbolizing the common folk with his bold, unrefined wisdom.

figures.name: Arjuna (Java)

ability.name: Divine Arrow
ability.description: Fire an arrow that bypasses all defenses; deal 10 damage to one target.

figures.description: The supreme hero of Javanese wayang, refined and spiritually advanced, whose inner battles and loves are celebrated in uniquely Javanese adaptations of the Mahabharata.

figures.name: Gatotkaca

ability.name: Sky Armor
ability.description: Become invulnerable to all physical attacks; fly above the battlefield for 2 turns.

figures.description: The mighty son of Bima in Javanese tradition, whose body is armor itself, who flies to battle on thunderclouds; greatest warrior of the Pandavas.

figures.name: Srikandi

ability.name: Arrow Storm
ability.description: Fire arrows at all enemies simultaneously; each takes 5 damage.

figures.description: The female warrior princess and expert archer of Javanese wayang, whose independence and martial skill have made her a feminist icon.

figures.name: Ken Dedes

ability.name: Sacred Womb Prophecy
ability.description: Reveal the destiny of one card; use its future power now.

figures.description: The sacred queen whose divine light shining between her legs signaled the coming of a new dynasty, mother of kings in Javanese history-myth.

figures.name: Ken Arok

ability.name: Cursed Kris
ability.description: Deal 8 damage to one enemy with the cursed blade; the wielder then takes 4 damage.

figures.description: The founding king of the Singhasari dynasty who rose from banditry through cunning and murder, wielding the cursed kris of Empu Gandring.

figures.name: Empu Gandring

ability.name: Death Kris Forged
ability.description: Create a cursed weapon card that deals double damage but injures its user too.

figures.description: The master blacksmith who forged the cursed kris that killed both himself and seven kings, whose dying curse haunted the Singhasari dynasty.

figures.name: Nyai Loro Kidul

ability.name: South Sea Covenant
ability.description: Form a pact with one card; both parties gain +3 to all stats but must serve each other.

figures.description: The mystical Queen of the South Sea, who forms a spiritual marriage with Javanese sultans, ruler of an underwater spirit kingdom dressed in green.

figures.name: Loro Blonyo

ability.name: Household Blessing
ability.description: Grant +2 to all stats to allied cards representing paired bonds.

figures.description: The paired spirit figures of the rice goddess and her consort, placed in Javanese homes to bless fertility and marital harmony.

figures.name: Jaka Tarub

ability.name: Stolen Garment
ability.description: Steal one ability or item from an enemy; they cannot use it while you hold it.

figures.description: The mortal who stole the flying garment of a celestial nymph to keep her as his wife, the classic Javanese tale of love between worlds.

figures.name: Dewi Nawang Wulan

ability.name: Celestial Return
ability.description: Escape any trap or binding; return to your true domain restoring all stats.

figures.description: The celestial nymph captured by Jaka Tarub, who secretly kept the rice supply magical until her garment was found, then returned to heaven.

figures.name: Damarwulan

ability.name: Humble Victory
ability.description: Win a contest despite lower stats through virtue; gain stats equal to the difference.

figures.description: The humble servant who rises to defeat the great rebel Minak Jinggo and win the queen's love, representing virtue overcoming pride.

figures.name: Minak Jinggo

ability.name: Rebel Lord
ability.description: Deal 8 damage to any noble or ruler card; take their position on the field.

figures.description: The powerful rebel lord of Blambangan who challenges the queen, portrayed as a giant with one eye, whose defeat enables Damarwulan's rise.

figures.name: Ratu Kalinyamat

ability.name: Sea Fleet Vengeance
ability.description: Summon a naval fleet; deal 6 damage to all enemy cards and establish sea dominance.

figures.description: The powerful 16th century queen of Jepara who organized naval expeditions and pursued justice with fierce determination, historical-mythologized heroine.

figures.name: Panji

ability.name: Disguised Prince
ability.description: Change your identity temporarily; cannot be targeted by name-specific abilities for 2 turns.

figures.description: The archetypal refined Javanese hero who wanders in disguise seeking his lost beloved Candrakirana, whose tales spread across Southeast Asia.
